newsitem.title: USA: Donnkenny at year low after downgrades.
newsitem.headline: Donnkenny at year low after downgrades.

text.p: Shares in Donnkenny Inc fell 2-9/16 to a 12-month low of 4-1/2 on Monday after downgrades by Bear Stearns and Prudential Securities.

Analysts at the two firms declined to comment about their reports. Prudential's Jack Pickler cut the company to sell from buy and Bear Stearns' Susan Sansbury downgraded it to unattractive from neutral.
Donnkenny's 36.28 percent fall led decliners on the Nasdaq. Volume was 3.9 million shares.

The women's sportswear maker's stock has fallen in recent weeks on news the company's auditors had resigned and it foresaw its 1996 results to be below analysts' expectations of $1.30 to $1.40 a share.
